The problem

The last-mile access gap

India’s informal workers face fragmented services, costly intermediaries and uncertain livelihoods.

44 Cr+

informal workers in India

8 / 10

of India’s workers are informal

50%

contribution to India’s GDP

Information exclusion

Low awareness of welfare eligibility, documentation and opportunities.

Economic vulnerability

Limited access to formal jobs, affordable finance and income stability.

Delivery failure

Digital-only services frequently miss low-literacy, low-connectivity populations.

Our solution

The 3T model: Team × Tech × Training

A human-assisted digital channel for services that are hard to access online alone.

TECHNOLOGY

  • Mobile and web platform
  • Scheme discovery and eligibility
  • Jobs and referrals
  • Banking, remittance, travel and recharge
  • Local-language information

TRAINING

  • Service-delivery capability
  • Financial and digital literacy
  • Customer service
  • Entrepreneurship and income generation
  • Ongoing mentorship

TEAM

  • Saathi agents and district partners
  • Doorstep assistance
  • Human escalation and support
  • Local stakeholder coordination
  • Community trust through local agents
Services

50+ services, one trusted place

Delivered through the app or with a Saathi near you.

Explore all services

Safe Jobs Connect

Verified job matching and referrals for blue-collar and migrant workers.

Social Welfare Schemes

Discover 500+ schemes, check eligibility and get assisted applications.

Neo Banking & Remittance

Fast, secure Indo-Nepal money transfer and everyday banking.

Micro ATM & AEPS

Cash withdrawal and balance enquiry with Aadhaar at your Saathi point.

PAN Card Center

New PAN applications and corrections, done right the first time.

Travel & Bill Payments

Bus and travel booking, recharges and utility bills — one-stop payments.

How it works

From need to solved — with a Saathi by your side

1

Reach out

Visit a nearby Saathi, open the app, or message us on WhatsApp.

2

Get guided

Your Saathi explains options and eligibility in your language.

3

Get it done

Apply, pay, transfer or register — securely, through authorised partners.

4

Stay supported

Track status and get follow-up help whenever you need it.

Impact

Dignity, savings and livelihoods — measured

average saving per transaction for workers

monthly earnings for 50% of Saathis from platform services

saved per transaction — no more full-day leave to send money home

title: Online Saathi — Aapka Apna Saathi | Last-mile access for India's informal workforce
description: Online Saathi connects India's informal and migrant workers to welfare schemes, jobs, banking, remittance and essential services through 2000+ trained local Saathis.
